title: Kirsten Johnson Wedding 10/08/11
author: madwire
excerpt: What an unbelievable wedding.  The snow blanketed the ground lightly that morning but cleared up with plenty of time for the wedding to go off without a hitch.  All the guests had a great time dancing while the music was operated from a completely different room!  A great wedding and a happy newlywwed couple.
